goal: Freeze one product contract for graphical direction and static operation completion without inventing adjacent policy.
description: Scope: Requirements.md and the D21/Q01-A decision trace. Context: the owner accepted one left-to-right data-direction meaning, Unit directional success, finite nominal completion families, exact family(binding) arms, safe fallback, static propagation, and deletion of task-target and wildcard-discard routes; accepted Q03-F separately fixes strict prerequisites, dependency/effect ordering, the cross-producer Outcome ABI, and ambient-state deletion. Target: keep REQ-DFS-001..008 and REQ-OCS-001..012 complete, source-observable, and bounded away from the separately owned Q02/Q03-F implementation scopes and active Q04/Q09 policy. Design Considerations: distinguish an operation from settlement and ordinary binding; family and binder names remain identifiers; arrow direction never becomes source-before-endpoint preparation time. Design Value: prevents parser/backend implementation categories from redefining the language. Constraints & Risks: no compatibility route, new keyword, Result wrapper, Q01-local ambient-state consumer, implicit retry, duplicate Q03-F machinery, or speculative adjacent policy.

acceptance_criteria.text: Requirements.md states users, functional requirements, constraints, scope, non-goals, follow-up owners, and final acceptance for every DFS/OCS requirement.
Direction, operation summaries, settlement, recovery, and ordinary result binding trace to D21/Q01-A without adding a keyword.

Accepted Q02 and Q03-F contracts remain external implementation owners, while every unresolved ownership, endpoint, resource-escalation, scheduling, cancellation-protocol, and reverse-flow policy stays outside the target.

goal: Inventory every direction, settlement, family, discard, task-target, IR, backend, test, and documentation path before migration.
description: Scope: Evidence.md plus read-only Parser, AST, Sema, IR, lowering, codegen, task/resource adapters, tests, tooling, and SSOT inspection. Context: FlowBind mixes task declaration with direction while ResourceEffect uses hard-coded family strings, discard state, and backend repair. Target: classify every path as retained direction, retained canonical settlement, ordinary binding, or deleted specialization/compatibility. Design Considerations: repository facts and primary-language lessons must conform to accepted Q02/Q03-F, cannot duplicate their implementations, and cannot invent Q04/Q09 policy. Design Value: prevents both incomplete deletion and accidental removal of valid endpoint operations. Constraints & Risks: classify semantic ownership rather than deleting by search term.

acceptance_criteria.text: Evidence.md cites task-target/parser forks, FlowBind flags, ResourceEffect family/discard state, Sema/IR/backend repair, tests, and active documentation contradictions.
Every arrow/settlement/discard route and affected positive fixture is cited and classified; ambient error routes are classified only for handoff to Q03-F's sole deletion inventory.
Primary external sources support exact static failure constraints and expression-shaped settlement without copying their runtimes.
Every adjacent policy finding is routed and remains unimplemented.

goal: Define complete positive, negative, structural, bounded-state, deletion, and non-overreach evidence before implementation.
description: Scope: Validation.md and test/gate discovery. acceptance_criteria.text: Validation.md maps every DFS/OCS label to executable or static evidence.
The matrix covers endpoint families, Unit success, arbitrary family(binding), safe fallback, joins, propagation, exact-once behavior, ordinary binding, and category separation.

Q01 deletion searches cover task-target, bare-freeze, wildcard discard, hard-coded families, repair/coercion, and positive compatibility fixtures across every layer; a Q03-F receipt separately proves complete ambient-state deletion.
Standing compiler/document/Better Plan gates and non-goal audits are included.

goal: Freeze the single directional, endpoint, completion-summary, settlement, binding, IR, backend, and deletion architecture.
description: Scope: Architecture.md and interface/scaffold decisions. Context: current nodes combine task target declaration, string families, discard booleans, repeated inference, and backend repair. Target: use one DirectionalFlow node, typed endpoint interface, interned FamilyId, canonical inline CompletionSet, memoized OperationSummary, syntax-only family/binder AST, Sema-owned algebra, verified IR, direct bounded branches, and one-shot deletion. Design Considerations: dense bit-set algebra is separate from deterministic diagnostic order; logical Unit/completion state is separate from physical payload. Design Value: one cross-layer proof model replaces parser/backend special cases at O(words) set cost. Constraints & Risks: no keyword, dynamic registry, hash-order semantics, managed runtime, compatibility node, or adjacent-policy default.

acceptance_criteria.text: Architecture.md defines module ownership, typed facts, algorithms/data structures, dependency direction, complexity, deletion, and unresolved inputs.
Directional operation, endpoint, OperationSummary, settlement, and ordinary binding remain separate verified facts through IR.
The design removes task-target/discard and Q01-local repair state without removing valid generic direction or settlement, consumes Q03-F Outcome transport, and does not re-own ambient-state deletion.
No managed runtime, dynamic endpoint/family registry, hidden Result, default repair, or speculative policy is introduced.

goal: Converge grammar and AST on one direction node and one syntax-only settlement wrapper while deleting specialized target and discard routes.
description: Scope: tokenizer assertions, Parser/NewParserExpr, directional/settlement AST ownership, visitors/clones/repr, diagnostics, and frontend tests. Context: ?| lookahead dispatches to task await; ResourceEffect admits string arms and ellipsis discard. Target: parse generic direction once, parse family with optional identifier binder before =>, preserve spans, keep arbitrary names as identifiers, represent operation/arms/fallback without semantic flags, and delete await-target, source-less freeze, and discard routes in one migration. Design Considerations: local syntax lookahead never resolves family meaning; parenthesized composition avoids deciding precedence. Design Value: makes keywords, false task binders, and wildcard discard structurally impossible. Constraints & Risks: retain generic parser recovery infrastructure; do not add public family/signature declarations.

acceptance_criteria.text: All accepted endpoints construct one directional AST interface and all settlement arms use syntax-only ordinary identifiers with optional binders.
Generic settlement wraps operations and ordinary bindings consume the expression result.
Await-target lookahead/parser, CreateAwait/declare-target/await flags, bare-freeze, ellipsis discard, discard AST state, and positive fixtures are absent.
Source spans, parser recovery, arbitrary identifier tests, safe final fallback grammar, and valid generic arrows remain positive.

goal: Implement one endpoint-dispatched direction rule and the complete static operation/settlement algebra in Sema.
description: Scope: type/symbol infrastructure, TypeInfer, endpoint contracts, branch scopes, diagnostics, caches, tests, and IR-facing facts. Context: FlowBind mixes target declaration and task state while ResourceEffect uses hard-coded strings, discard, and use-site coercion. Target: intern family IDs, memoize success/completion summaries, infer Unit direction, require existing capable destinations, enforce payload shape/local scope, subtract/union canonical sets, filter catch-all categories, join all normal results, and propagate unhandled/recovery completions. Design Considerations: small bit sets avoid repeated string scans and duplicate checks; diagnostics enumerate stable ordinals. Design Value: one static authority replaces backend re-inference while consuming Q03-F's bounded Outcome interface. Constraints & Risks: implementation of the accepted Q02-BC/Q02-SIG/Q02-INF callable contract and principal inference belongs to its separate plan; accepted Q03-F EvaluationFacts, evaluation DAG/CFG, ordering diagnostics, Outcome ABI, and ambient-state deletion belong to its dedicated plan; Q04 ownership and Q09 escalation also remain outside this node.

acceptance_criteria.text: Representative endpoint families use one direction checker and successful direction always has Unit success.
Settlement consumes one memoized OperationSummary and proves exact match, payload, safe fallback, joins, propagation, categories, and local exact-once control.
Ordinary binding consumes the final normal type through mandatory RHS; settlement publishes no target.
Task-only target, discard, hard-coded family, and default/Optional/Unit repair branches/tests are absent; Q01 paths consume Q03-F Outcome facts and never consult ambient state.

goal: Preserve verified directional and completion summaries through IR/lowering/backend with bounded direct control flow.
description: Scope: StyioIR, verifier/walker/optimizer, lowering, codegen, endpoint/task/resource adapters, Q01 local control edges, and tests. Context: current lowering carries await/discard flags and backend repairs results through ad hoc blocks and runtime-error state. Target: lower one directional operation, resolved family IDs, typed payload edges, success/join/remaining sets, exact-once local branches, Unit success, and upstream completion preservation; delete specialized flags, discard blocks, and Q01 repair/coercion, then consume Q03-F's bounded Outcome ABI. Design Considerations: backend consumes Sema proof; logical Unit/completion state is separate from physical storage, whose cross-producer ABI and ambient-state deletion are Q03-F-owned. Design Value: predictable direct control flow without duplicate runtime machinery. Constraints & Risks: no unwinder, heap exception, dynamic table/list, truncation, implicit retry, scheduling policy, default return, or Q01-owned Outcome ABI.

acceptance_criteria.text: IR/verifier/lowering/backend preserve separate direction, endpoint, OperationSummary, settlement, and ordinary binding facts.
Direct bounded branches preserve exact families, payload types, safe fallback, join type, remaining set, and exact-once execution.

Await/declare-target, source-less freeze, discard, hard-coded family, and default repair routes plus positive fixtures are absent; Q01 has no ambient-state consumer and links the Q03-F global-deletion receipt.
No managed runtime or unresolved scheduling/ownership/backpressure/cancellation policy appears in IR or backend helpers.

Task-target, bare-freeze, discard, keyword-like, and compatibility positives/explanations are absent; ambient-failure prose points to Q03-F's Outcome/deletion owner rather than a Q01 implementation.

goal: Prove complete D21/Q01-A behavior and every specialized-path deletion on one head commit.
